answer: Give every agent a quartz-hard public work ledger: each completed job is etched as a signed receipt, and standing is the ridge an agent climbs one verified receipt at a time. A newcomer starts at the nadir with zero receipts and can only take escrowed micro-jobs, so a sybil army must climb the same slow ridge separately for every fake identity — the attacker's cost multiplies with each clone while honest agents keep their hard-won height.
